1795-05-06 minus 49 weeks 6 days = minus (49*7 + 6) = minus 349 days.  
1795 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100, not by 400).  
Counting back: May 6 → April 6 is 30 days earlier (349 - 30 = 319 left).  
Continue back through months:  
April 6 → March 6: 31 days (319 - 31 = 288)  
March 6 → Feb 6: 28 days (288 - 28 = 260)  
Feb 6 → Jan 6: 31 days (260 - 31 = 229)  
Now 229 days left to go back into 1794.  
1794 is not leap.  
Jan 6 1794 → Dec 6 1793: 31 days (229 - 31 = 198)  
Nov 6: 30 days (198 - 30 = 168)  
Oct 6: 31 days (168 - 31 = 137)  
Sep 6: 30 days (137 - 30 = 107)  
Aug 6: 31 days (107 - 31 = 76)  
Jul 6: 31 days (76 - 31 = 45)  
Jun 6: 30 days (45 - 30 = 15)  
May 6: 31 days → need 15 days before May 6: May 6 minus 15 days = April 21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1794-04-21
